card.name: The word diabetes in insipidus or mellitus
card.fires_on: The word "diabetes" in label text, mainly just before "insipidus" or "mellitus". Weaker on small words like "to", "or" or "(" in glucose or COPD staging lists.

modes.label: Diabetes before insipidus/mellitus

modes.description: Small words in lists of lab categories or disease stages, such as normal to high or normal or impaired glucose.
